title: Joint Manipulation (High-Velocity Low-Amplitude Thrust)
lead: A high-velocity, low-amplitude thrust (grade V) applied at the end of available range, sometimes producing an audible cavitation ("pop").

blocks.text: A high-velocity, low-amplitude thrust (grade V) applied at the end of available range, sometimes producing an audible cavitation ("pop"). The pop is a gas release in the joint and is not required for benefit [Ref – to verify].

Short-term pain relief and improved movement in selected spinal and peripheral conditions. Example: a clinical prediction rule for lumbar manipulation in acute low back pain was proposed (recent onset, no symptoms below the knee, low fear avoidance, hypomobility, good hip rotation) [Ref – to verify; validation mixed].

items: Serious adverse events are rare but most concerning with cervical manipulation (cervical artery injury association; causation debated) [Ref – to verify].
Get specific informed consent including material risks.
Prefer thoracic manipulation or mobilisation for neck pain when risk factors are present.
Must be trained and competent; follow local regulation.

rows: Patient arms crossed, therapist's hand under the target segment, thrust through the patient's arms toward the couch
Lock segments above and below; thrust through the pelvis
Used in the original prediction rule

blocks.text: Use manipulation when there is a clear mechanical presentation, no contraindication, informed consent, and when mobilisation and exercise alone are insufficient or the patient prefers it. Always combine with active management.

items: **Why prefer thoracic manipulation for neck pain in some patients?** Lower risk with evidence of short-term neck pain relief.
**What must consent include?** Material risks, alternatives and the right to decline.
**What is a grade V technique?** High-velocity, low-amplitude thrust.
**Should manipulation be used alone?** No, combine with exercise and education.

sections.title: Now You Should Be Able To

items: Explain indications, risks and consent requirements for manipulation.
Make a defensible decision about when to use it.

sections.A: Manipulation (grade V) range ke aakhir mein tez aur chhota thrust hai.
sections.B: Kuch reedh aur doosre joints ke maslon mein thori der ka dard ka aaraam aur behtar movement ke liye.
sections.C: Serious nuqsan kam hote hain lekin gardan ki manipulation mein sab se zyada fikr hai. Screening aur patient ki marzi zaroori hai.
sections.D: Aam techniques: thoracic supine thrust, lumbar side-lying rotation waghaira.
sections.E: Manipulation tab karein jab saaf mechanical masla ho, koi contraindication na ho aur patient raazi ho.
sections.F: Sawaal hal karein. 'Pop' ki aawaz zaroori nahi; gardan dard mein aksar thoracic manipulation behtar aur mehfooz hai.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
